certification.name: Cisco Cybersecurity Operations Fundamentals Specialization
certification.description: Seven-course Cisco specialization covering security operations center basics, network and endpoint monitoring, attack analysis and incident handling for entry-level analysts. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes, with no projects and no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 12 weeks at 2 hours a week.
